proof_body:
by
  intro V _ _ a b p
  let K : Submodule ℝ V := Submodule.span ℝ {a, b}
  have hK : FiniteDimensional ℝ K := FiniteDimensional.span_of_finite ℝ (by simp)
  obtain ⟨s, t, hst⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_pair.mp (K.starProjection_apply_mem p)
  refine ⟨s, t, ?_⟩
  have horth := K.sub_starProjection_mem_orthogonal p
  rw [← hst] at horth
  have ha : a ∈ K := Submodule.subset_span (by simp)
  have hb : b ∈ K := Submodule.subset_span (by simp)
  exact ⟨by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact (Submodule.mem_orthogonal _ _).mp horth a ha, by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact (Submodule.mem_orthogonal _ _).mp horth b hb⟩
target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (a b p : V), ∃ s t : ℝ, inner ℝ (p - (s • a + t • b)) a = 0 ∧ inner ℝ (p - (s • a + t • b)) b = 0
